review: I like the look: each stage has its own colour and the ghost is easy to see. First Steps and Crumble Bridge feel friendly, and Laser Gate is clear because I can see which beams are on. But Spring Loaded stops me dead. My ghost stands next to a spring in front of a long spike row for 45 seconds and nobody out of 100 gets past, so I would never see stages 7 and 8. Saw Mill also comes too early: saws float everywhere and I die in five seconds. Ferry Lines has many falls for a stage with almost no hazards.
best: Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate are readable, pretty and beatable with a little care.
worst: Spring Loaded is impossible, the spring before the spike row does not get anyone across, so the game ends at stage 6.
